title: Bo luat Hinh su 2015 - Dieu 249
source: Bo luat Hinh su 2015, sua doi 2017, Dieu 249
content: Dieu 249 quy dinh toi tang tru trai phep chat ma tuy. Khung co ban ap dung voi mot so truong hop tang tru heroin, cocaine, methamphetamine, amphetamine, MDMA hoac cac chat ma tuy khac theo khoi luong luat dinh. Hinh phat co the la phat tu tu 1 nam den 5 nam. Cac khung tang nang co muc phat tu cao hon khi khoi luong lon, co nhieu chat, tai pham nguy hiem hoac co tinh tiet nghiem trong.

title: Luat Phong chong ma tuy 2021 - Cai nghien
source: Luat Phong chong ma tuy 2021, Chuong V
content: Luat Phong chong ma tuy 2021 quy dinh cac hinh thuc cai nghien ma tuy gom cai nghien tu nguyen tai gia dinh, cai nghien tu nguyen tai cong dong, cai nghien tu nguyen tai co so cai nghien ma tuy va cai nghien bat buoc tai co so cai nghien ma tuy. Viec lua chon hinh thuc phu thuoc vao tinh trang nguoi nghien, dieu kien gia dinh, cong dong va quyet dinh cua co quan co tham quyen.

title: Luat Phong chong ma tuy 2021 - Trach nhiem gia dinh
content: Gia dinh co trach nhiem giao duc thanh vien ve tac hai cua ma tuy, quan ly va ngan ngua viec su dung trai phep chat ma tuy, phoi hop voi co quan chuc nang trong phong chong ma tuy, dong vien va ho tro nguoi nghien tham gia cai nghien va tai hoa nhap cong dong.

title: Luat Phong chong ma tuy 2021 - Chat ma tuy
source: Luat Phong chong ma tuy 2021, Dieu 2
content: Chat ma tuy la chat gay nghien, chat huong than duoc quy dinh trong danh muc do Chinh phu ban hanh. Tien chat la hoa chat khong the thieu trong qua trinh dieu che, san xuat chat ma tuy. Hanh vi su dung, mua ban, tang tru, van chuyen trai phep chat ma tuy bi nghiem cam.

title: Nghi dinh ve danh muc chat ma tuy
content: Danh muc chat ma tuy duoc chia thanh cac nhom quan ly. Nhom I bao gom cac chat ma tuy bi cam su dung trong y hoc va doi song, nhu heroin, cocaine, methamphetamine, MDMA va cac chat co tinh chat tuong tu theo danh muc phap ly hien hanh.

title: Xu ly nguoi su dung trai phep chat ma tuy
content: Nguoi su dung trai phep chat ma tuy co the bi lap ho so quan ly, xac dinh tinh trang nghien, giao duc tai xa phuong thi tran, hoac ap dung bien phap cai nghien theo quy dinh. Neu co hanh vi tang tru, mua ban, van chuyen trai phep chat ma tuy thi co the bi xu ly hinh su theo Bo luat Hinh su.

title: Citation demo news
source: Tong hop tin tuc ma tuy
content: Tin tuc lien quan ma tuy thuong de cap cac vu bat giu, dieu tra, xet xu, cong tac tuyen truyen va cai nghien. Khi tra loi ve mot vu viec cu the, he thong chi nen dua ra thong tin neu context co neu ro ten nguon, ngay thang va noi dung su kien.
